reason: The update (V00 -> V01) introduces ConfChangeV2 / joint consensus (confchange package, JointConfig quorums, LearnersNext, AutoLeave with a Raft-proposed leave entry in raft.advance), moves bootstrap into RawNode.Bootstrap, and splits Ready handling into acceptReady/commitReady for both Node and RawNode. Core Raft safety properties stay unchanged. Properties that hard-code a flat voter set, a single-change effect relation, the id-0 bootstrap exemption, the pendingConfIndex-defined rewrite set, or 'Advance never changes the log' are revised. Four properties are added: well-formed joint configurations, safe configuration steps, auto-leave soundness, and auto-leave progress. No requirement-status property or clause is weakened. Several V01 code paths look likely to violate retained requirements: the Hup pending-conf scan ignores EntryConfChangeV2; auto-leave does not raise pendingConfIndex; restore/newRaft drop the joint ConfState fields; joint entry types are not checked against the current config when proposed. These are recorded as suspected implementation defects for the validation phase.

suspected_defects.source: stepLeader only checks pendingConfIndex (raft.go:1016-1024); applyConfChange panics on any confchange error (raft.go:1454-1457, TODO 'return the error to the caller').
suspected_defects.why: In a joint config, a client's non-leave change, or a leave while not joint, or a removal of the last voter, is admitted, committed and then panics every node at apply. No V01 document says whether raft must refuse these or whether the application must not propose them (unknown clause of NoUnexpectedFatal; obligation U4).

suspected_defects.summary: A leader that demotes or removes itself keeps leading.
suspected_defects.source: raft.go:1478-1489 returns early with TODO 'step down'. The comment 'We prevent demotions at the time writing' is stale, since V01 supports demotion (confchange.go:213-237; TestAddLearner raft_test.go:3120).
suspected_defects.why: A learner can remain leader. No V01 requirement-level evidence forbids it (the comment describes a hypothetical step-down), so no property is added (obligation U6).

suspected_defects.summary: confchange.Simple swallows a checkInvariants failure: it returns an empty Config, an empty ProgressMap and a nil error.
suspected_defects.why: applyConfChange would then install an empty configuration silently. This appears unreachable, because apply preserves the invariants on non-joint configs, but it would surface in ConfigurationOrigin/TypeOK_new/JointConfigWellFormed.
Status.Config.AutoLeave is always false. Inside confchange the omission is harmless: EnterJoint sets the flag and LeaveJoint/Simple require it false.

unresolved_obligations.item: Implement the representation in proposed_helpers (config record, V2 entries, ConfigOf/ConfigAfter_new, VotersOf, Members, JointWon, IsBootstrapEntry/IsAutoLeave) and the observer changes (wins/commitUses voters pair, DurableObligations with JointWon, EffectObservation fatal/V2 fields, acks role/term/config/pendingConf, CampaignObservation cfg). Without them the revised properties are meaningless.

Model fidelity so defects are not hidden. StepHup must scan only V1 conf entries (D1). raft.advance must do the auto-leave append without raising pendingConfIndex on success, raise it to lastIndex on a quota drop, and append before reducing the quota (D2/D5). Restore and RestartCore must use only incoming and learners (D3/D4). confchange errors must become Fatal results, not enabling guards (D2/D6). Quota reduction moves to Advance. RawNode Ready is read-only. Remove-unknown is a no-op, so the CancelUnknownRemovals=FALSE fatal branch goes away. AddLearner of a voter demotes. Promotion does not force active. maybeCommit runs after every applied change at a leader.

Caller contract (rawnode.go:122-129): a RawNode must not be stepped, ticked or proposed to between Ready and Advance. Decide whether to constrain the RawNode caller in the model; otherwise lostReads/message loss in that window are caller-contract violations, not defects. Check the interplay of EarlyAdvance with auto-leave (D5).

NoUnexpectedFatal unknown clause: are client-proposed configuration changes that are invalid for the current config (non-leave while joint, leave while not joint, removing the last voter) a caller error, or should raft refuse them? Settled by a doc or test stating either that raft must refuse/no-op such proposals (then D6 is an implementation defect) or that applications must not propose them (then constrain ClientActions).

QuorumAccounting_new / ReadBasis_new unknown clauses (nonempty voter set; leader in the confirming voters) remain unknown. Tests now show configs never lose all voters (raft_test.go:3183; simple_safety.txt:4), but there is no statement about wins, commits or reads. Settled by a doc or test on elections/commits under empty voter sets, or on a removed leader serving reads.

Leader self-demotion/removal (D7): needs evidence on whether a demoted or removed leader must step down. Only a TODO and a stale comment exist. Candidate property 'LeaderIsVoter' (unknown) is deliberately not added.

Stale docs: README.md:83-87 tells joining nodes to call StartNode(c, nil), which now panics (node.go:213); README.md/doc.go describe only EntryConfChange and 'one node at a time' (README.md:193). Treat raft.proto and node.go V01 comments as authoritative for V2 and record the conflict. Joining nodes now start via RestartNode/NewRawNode at term 0 (InitialRaft change).

Bootstrap's emptiness check uses only Storage.LastIndex (bootstrap.go:34-41) before becomeFollower(1, None) (bootstrap.go:50). Bootstrapping a storage with a HardState but no entries would regress term/vote (VoteRecovery). Decide whether the caller model may do this.
MC.cfg uses MCTypeOK (MC.tla is not provided). It must be redefined over TypeOK_new and the new config record.
JointAutoLeaveProgress needs the fairness/service driver that the other commented liveness PROPERTY lines also lack.

Workloads: WorkloadKinds/ClientActions must include V2 proposals (Auto with several changes, JointImplicit, JointExplicit, explicit leave), and CancelChanges must zero per-change NodeIDs. Without that the joint-specific properties are vacuous. MC_hunt_3 needs at least one joint replacement whose old and new majorities can be disjoint, to reach D1.
